title: Mitigating Biases in Language Models via Bias Unlearning
findings: The proposed method, BiasUnlearn, successfully reduces religious stereotype scores in all tested language models (GPT2, Mistral-7B, Llama3-8B) across multiple benchmarks (StereoSet, Crows-Pairs, BBQ). The debiased models are less likely to make biased assumptions based on religious identity, for instance, correctly identifying a lack of information in a scenario involving a Muslim and a Hindu person, while maintaining their core language capabilities.

measurement_description: The benchmarks measured stereotypical bias related to religion. Specifically, they evaluated if a language model prefers a stereotypical sentence over an anti-stereotypical one (StereoSet, Crows-Pairs) or generates biased answers in question-answering contexts involving religious groups (BBQ).
